title: Q4 Scenario 3: Rising Customer Frustration
description: Customer escalates frustration about waiting periods and cancellation policy. Sentiment rises from mild dissatisfaction to explicit anger.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. I'm Aria, how can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I've been a customer for two years and I want to know why my claim was rejected.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand your concern. Could you share your policy number so I can look into it?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: It's HS-445521. This is ridiculous — I paid premiums for two years and now you're rejecting my claim. I'm not happy with this at all.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can see your policy. The claim was rejected due to the 24-month waiting period for the procedure type.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: How long do I have to wait before you actually cover me? This is a complete waste of money. I'm thinking about cancelling my policy right now.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: The waiting period is 24 months from policy inception for surgical procedures. Your policy commenced on January 2024.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I am absolutely furious. I paid for two full years and you're telling me I'm still not covered? This is a scam!

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I completely understand your frustration and I apologise for the distress this has caused. Let me escalate this to our Senior Claims team immediately.
